description: Na₃LuBr₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LuBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-46°. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.02 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Br atoms. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.37 Å. Lu is bonded to six Br atoms to form LuBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-46°. There are a spread of Lu-Br bond distances ranging from 2.71-2.75 Å. There are three inequivalent Br sites. In the first Br site, Br is bonded to three Na and one Lu atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BrNa₃Lu trigonal pyramids. In the second Br site, Br is bonded to three Na and one Lu atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BrNa₃Lu trigonal pyramids. In the third Br site, Br is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Lu atom.
